sources.title: KITE — Kiel Institute Trade Policy Evaluation - GitHub
sources.snippet: The KITE model provides a tool for simulating and estimating various types of (trade) policy changes. The underlying model uses a computable general equilibrium (CGE) framework of the type that is commonly described as "New Quantitative Trade Model". The model has originally been developed by Caliendo & Parro (2015). They built a multi-sector version of the Ricardian trade model of Eaton ...
